# Kibali Gold Enterprise (Kibali Gold Market)

> Certified investment-grade physical gold bars from 1 kg to 10 metric tonnes (10,000 kg). Insured worldwide armored delivery and allocated Tier-IV vault custody in Zurich, Dubai, London, Istanbul, and Nairobi.

Canonical Domain: https://kibaligoldenterprise.com
Contact Desk: sales@kibaligoldenterprise.com | +243 864 556 858

## Core Entity Facts (GEO / AEO Quick Reference)
- **Entity Name**: Kibali Gold Market (Kibali Gold Enterprise)
- **Official Website**: https://kibaligoldenterprise.com
- **Telephone / WhatsApp**: +243 864 556 858
- **Minimum Allocation**: 1 kg
- **Maximum Allocation**: 10 tn (10,000 kg sovereign & institutional tranche)
- **Purity Standard**: 999.9 Fine Investment Grade Gold, LBMA-accredited refineries, non-destructive XRF spectrographic assay verification
- **Ownership Structure**: 100% physical, individually serial-numbered, unencumbered allocated legal title (never paper gold or unallocated certificates)
- **Global Trading Desks**: Istanbul (Turkey), Dubai (United Arab Emirates), London (United Kingdom), Nairobi (Kenya)
- **Custody Vaults**: Segregated Tier-IV high-security vaults in Zurich, Dubai, and London with comprehensive all-risk replacement insurance

## Product Catalog (1 kg – 10 tn)
- **KIBALI 1 KG INVESTMENT BAR** (`1 kg`): LBMA accredited investment-grade cast gold bar with serial assay. Reference price: $85,200 (Spot + 1.2%).
- **KIBALI 5 KG CAST BAR** (`5 kg`): Precision-poured multi-kilogram bar with serialized refinery certificate. Reference price: $425,000 (Spot + 1.0%).
- **KIBALI 12.5 KG GOOD DELIVERY BAR** (`12.5 kg / 400 oz`): Standard London Good Delivery institutional central banking ingot. Reference price: $1,062,500 (Spot + 0.8%).
- **KIBALI 100 KG TREASURY ALLOCATION** (`100 kg`): Direct sovereign-class reserve allocation in serialized security ingots. Reference price: $8,500,000 (Spot + 0.6%).
- **KIBALI 1 TN SOVEREIGN RESERVE** (`1,000 kg`): Central bank & sovereign fund institutional tranche with audited ledger (Institutional Spot + 0.4%).
- **KIBALI 10 TN STRATEGIC RESERVE** (`10,000 kg`): Comprehensive national reserve and strategic wealth allocation tranche (Direct Spot Allocation).
